title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
task: Real-time interactive voice-controlled video generation
key_results: 540p video at 42 FPS on consumer GPUs; infinite-length generation without drift or distortion
comments: Impressive real-time performance on commodity hardware, though practical quality assessment across diverse content is missing.

task: Auditing video understanding benchmarks for evaluation criteria
key_results: 55% of benchmark samples solvable without visual input; SoTA models perform marginally above random after filtering shortcuts
comments: Critically exposes benchmark quality issues, though the filtered 'true' video challenges may be too narrow for practical applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video-LLM benchmark performance conflates visual perception, linguistic reasoning, and knowledge priors
hypotheses.result: Majority of samples are solvable via non-visual shortcuts; substantial capability gap remains in true video-native tasks

task: Zero-shot compositional action recognition avoiding object-driven shortcuts
key_results: RCORE reduces shortcut diagnostics and improves compositional generalization on Sth-com and EK100-com
comments: Well-motivated diagnostic approach, but improvements are incremental and limited to two datasets.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Object-driven shortcuts arise from sparse supervision and verb-object learning asymmetry

title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
task: Evaluating proactive agents on real-world multi-turn tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Base model capabilities and agent framework design jointly shape real-world performance
hypotheses.result: Comprehensive comparisons reveal disentangled contributions of model and framework choices

title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
task: Long-horizon event-based video reconstruction and prediction
key_results: Outperforms SoTA on reconstruction, prediction, and interpolation; superior temporal coherence and zero-shot generalization
comments: Strong technical contributions (autoregressive unrolling, adaptive context switching) address real temporal drift challenges.

title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
task: Benchmarking scientific lineage reasoning and idea generation
key_results: 1,961 lineage traces across 10 domains; SoTA reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy on reasoning; compositional bottleneck identified
comments: Novel framework for tracing scientific inheritance is ambitious, but low SoTA performance suggests tasks may be extremely difficult or under-specified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured lineage context helps LLMs reason about scientific inheritance

task: On-device image-to-video generation with cinematic effects
key_results: 40× speedup vs. teacher; 0.6s per step on H200 GPU, 20s on mobile SoC; <1GB footprint; comparable visual quality
comments: Excellent compression and deployment story, though detailed quality comparisons and diverse cinematic effects are not quantified.

task: Steering Arabic dialect generation via sparse neurons and distributed directions
key_results: Sparse neurons encode dialect features; amplification/suppression steers outputs; vector-steering extracts dialect-specific directions; no fine-tuning required

title: Molecular mechanisms of mitochondrial Ca2+ exchanger NCLX

comments: High-resolution structures illuminate conserved exchange mechanism but broader ion selectivity remains mechanistically underspecified at atomic detail.

model_io.model: NCLX cryo-EM structure (cytosolic-facing occluded and open states)

hypotheses.hypothesis: NCLX shares conserved alternating-access mechanism with NCX homologs via TM 1 and 6 sliding motions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Absence of canonical Na⁺-binding residues confers broader ion selectivity

title: Protein stability is determined by single-site bias rather than pairwise covariance
task: Determine relative contributions of single-site bias versus pairwise covariance to protein stability
key_results: Sequences maximizing single-site bias (excluding pair correlations) show highest stability; pair correlations instead enhance enzyme activity in three families tested; elimination of covariant residue pairs increases thermal stability
comments: Surprising dissociation between stability and covariance suggests these metrics optimize different fitness components; practical utility limited by offset of stability gains against reduced catalytic activity.

model_io.model: Potts model for protein sequence design
outputs: designed protein sequences with varied bias/covariance content

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pair correlations improve protein stability prediction
hypotheses.result: Refuted: sequences excluding pair correlations achieve maximum stability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pair correlations enhance fitness across all protein properties
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: pair correlations greatly increase enzyme activity but reduce stability

title: Mechanochemical interactions dictate obstacle-induced cell turning by breaking symmetry in actin dynamics
task: Elucidate mechanochemical basis of obstacle-induced cell turning
key_results: Optimal substrate stiffness of 0.1–1 pN/nm maximizes turning; asymmetry in actin polymerization and retrograde flow at leading edge drives reorientation; chemotactic signaling spatially redistributes Arp2/3 and myosin II to amplify turning rates

model_io.model: Theoretical framework of actin dynamics and obstacle interaction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Substrate–clutch mechanics dominate actin response to compression more than obstacle stiffness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: adhesion engagement suppresses retrograde flow; obstacle stiffness has negligible influence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elevated diffusion selectively enhances polymerization at free edge
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: polymerization increased at free edge without altering constrained-edge dynamics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chemotactic signaling increases turning rates by spatial redistribution of actin regulators
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: dual remodeling of Arp2/3 and myosin II shifts optimal stiffness and increases turning

model_io.model: Mouse oocytes in primordial and early growing follicles with conditional eIF2B subunit knockout

hypotheses.hypothesis: eIF2B subunit depletion (except Eif2b1) triggers oocyte apoptosis through integrated stress response, DNA damage accumulation, and mitochondrial dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Eif2b2/3/4/5-cKO oocytes showed integrated stress response upregulation, increased DDR proteins, mitochondrial dysfunction, and elevated ROS/apoptosis markers

title: Single-cell RNA sequencing of hematopoietic and non-hematopoietic cells defines a distinct signature in atopic and NRG1 mouse lung

title: Experimental study on cement paste using the ultrasonic pulse transmission method

title: Elastic wave interaction with a stressed half-space containing voids
task: Analyzing SV-wave reflection in stressed, void-containing elastic half-spaces
key_results: Incident SV-wave in initially stressed isotropic porous half-space generates two reflected modes: P-wave (affected by both stress and void parameters) and SV-wave (stress-dependent only); closed-form reflection coefficients derived analytically
comments: Theoretical framework combining Biot incremental deformations with porous elasticity theory; results clarify distinct stress vs. porosity influences on wave propagation in geophysical media.

comments: Counterintuitive result that local pseudopotentials improve accuracy suggests distinctive neural-network ansatz properties; substantial efficiency gain positions method for practical large-system applications.
